_comment: Tier-2 for febio::elasticity_mms#2. The shipped MMS deck with every *X) / *Y) / *Z) in its <Loads> body-load expressions lowercased reads 'Reading file ...SUCCESS!' and is then killed by SIGSEGV with no ERROR box and nothing naming the bad symbol; the same deck with uppercase symbols runs to normal termination. The read_success half is required, because it is what makes an early-timestep crash in a deck with math expressions diagnosable at all. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
